rows.text: with q = qword `[rcx]`: returns 0 at once when q is 0; otherwise it branches on q's low byte k. For k = 7 it takes the object `007BC2A0`() returns as a critical section (`008C20B8` EnterCriticalSection), calls `007BC2B0`(&q) and, when that is non-null, its virtual `+0x10`; it leaves the section (`008C20C0`) on every path and returns 0 when the lookup is null or the virtual returns 0, 1 or 3 when it returns those, else 2. For k = 2, 8 or 9 it does the same with `007B44B0`/`007B44C0`, `007B7950`/`007B77E0` or `007B8050`/`007B7FD0` and the virtual `+0xA8`, and returns 0 for a null lookup or a 0 result, 1 for 1, 3 for 4, else 2. Any other k returns 0
